scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings and cars parked along both sides. The street is paved with gray concrete and has white lines painted on it. There are several trees lining the sidewalk and a few pedestrians walking along the street. A large white truck with green lettering is parked on the right side of the street. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures made of stone and brick. They have ornate facades and balconies. Some of them have awnings over the windows.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with gray concrete and has white lines painted on it. There are also some trees planted along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are no benches or tables outside the buildings. However, there are some trash cans and recycling bins placed along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are leafy and provide shade for pedestrians.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a yellow sign with black lettering and a green sign with white lettering.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet and peaceful, with only a few people visible.
